```
File: /tmp/claude-10001/-ai-inventor-aii-data-runs-run-aMfESsKemlKH-4-gen-paper-repo--4-assemble-paper-paper-workspace/de02e3da-c257-4450-9104-92d37cf659e2/scratchpad/plot_fig3.py

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Render fig3_v0.pdf and fig3_v0.png from fig3_spec.json."""
import json, pathlib
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

FIGDIR = pathlib.Path("/ai-inventor/aii_data/runs/run_aMfESsKemlKH/4_gen_paper_repo/_4_assemble_paper/paper/workspace/figures")

with open(FIGDIR / "fig3_spec.json") as f:
    spec = json.load(f)

plt.rcParams.update({
    "font.family": "serif",
    "font.serif": ["CMU Serif", "DejaVu Serif", "Times New Roman", "serif"],
    "mathtext.fontset": "cm",
})

rows = spec["rows"]
colours = {k: v["colour"] for k, v in spec["groups"].items()}
legend_labels = {k: v["legend"] for k, v in spec["groups"].items()}

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(spec["width_in"], 3.6))

y_positions = list(range(len(rows) - 1, -1, -1))

for row, y in zip(rows, y_positions):
    c = colours[row["group"]]
    ax.errorbar(row["point"], y,
                xerr=[[row["point"] - row["ci_low"]], [row["ci_high"] - row["point"]]],
                fmt='o', color=c, markersize=7, capsize=4, linewidth=1.5, capthick=1.2)

ax.axvline(spec["null_line"], color='grey', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.8)
ax.set_xlim(spec["xlim"])

for row, y in zip(rows, y_positions):
    if row["annotation"]:
        ax.annotate(row["annotation"], xy=(spec["xlim"][1] + 0.02, y),
                    fontsize=8, va='center', annotation_clip=False)

ax.set_yticks(y_positions)
ax.set_yticklabels([r["label"] for r in rows])
ax.set_xlabel(spec["xlabel"])

handles = []
for g, lab in legend_labels.items():
    handles.append(plt.Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w',
                              markerfacecolor=colours[g], markersize=8, label=lab))
ax.legend(handles=handles, loc='upper left', fontsize=7.5, frameon=True,
          fancybox=False, edgecolor='grey')

ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout()

fig.savefig(FIGDIR / "fig3_v0.pdf", bbox_inches='tight')
fig.savefig(FIGDIR / "fig3_v0.png", dpi=200, bbox_inches='tight')
print("Saved fig3_v0.pdf and fig3_v0.png")
```
